notes.title: Seqitaire Planned For Release in January 2024
notes.notes:
Dear Shuzzler Community,

We are excited to announce that Seqitaire is planned for release in January 2024! Please wishlist using the link below to show support and receive updates on release status:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732170/Seqitaire/

If you enjoyed playing Shuzzler, you will find the format of Seqitaire very familiar, except that Seqitaire is a math puzzle game with the tiles having numbers and operators (+, -, ×, ÷) on them instead of letters. The objective is to produce the number on the active card using number and operator tiles available in the tile grid. In addition to a number or operator, each tile is associated with a suit (diamonds, hearts, spades, or clubs). Cards often require using only tiles associated with particular suits or selecting tiles that alternate between black and red suits when adding, subtracting, multiplying, or dividing to output the number specified by the cards. In this way, Seqitaire can be described as a pattern-matching game as well as a math, number game.

Players whom found Shuzzler's gameplay unforgiving, should appreciate that all levels in Seqitaire come with the option to play with random tiles or preset tiles that have been playtested to ensure there are multiple winning solutions for each level. There are separate saved scores and leaderboards that apply if the game is being played with the randomized tiles setting on or off.

At the time of release, Seqitaire will come with 10 playable levels out of 40 planned levels. This should be up to 3-4 hours of content. We are looking to the Steam community for feedback that would inform the design of the remaining levels. 

Happy Holidays!
- Shuzzler & Seqitaire Dev Team

notes.title: Update 4.3 - Star System Revamped & New Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
Steam Leaderboards for high scores have arrived for all 35 levels of the untimed content! Scores earned on these levels will automatically be submitted to Steam leaderboards provided that the level is successfully completed (i.e. all main objectives achieved). 

The second major change to the game is the way the star award system works for individual levels. Instead of being based on points, stars awarded are now based on letter tiles cleared from the tile grid at the end of the game relative to the total number of letter tiles possible (including starting tiles, tiles added to the tile grid from action cards, and those added from STARTS WITH and ENDS WITH point cards). Here is a breakdown of the new criteria for earning stars:

1 Star - clear 55% of letter tiles...

Stars earned out of 5 possible are still shown in post-game even if the level was not completed (but without accompanying animation), but will no longer show in the Level screen unless the level was completed.

Additional bug fixes and improvements applied in this update are listed below.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed animation not showing when earning points from individual letter tiles. When this animation plays successfully, individual white star-like orbs representing the points gained from the letter tiles ascend from locations of cleared tiles to score stat in upper left-hand side of screen. 
Improved Card Artwork:

 Organ category card
 Greek Letter category card
 Physics category card
 Wild category card

notes.title: Patch 4.2.2 - Hotfixes For Bugs In Versus AI Mode
notes.notes:
This patch fixes bugs that appear in Versus AI mode only, so is not applicable to main game content. These bugs were encountered during the livestream with influencer ALEDream on February 22. Here is a description of the bugs and fixes:
[olist]
 Fixed game-crashing bug that occurs when completing a game in Versus AI mode.
 Fixed error where each row of letter tiles added to the tile grid is a duplicate of previous row of letter tiles added to the tile grid.
 Fixed bug where starred tiles appear in Versus AI mode. Starred tiles should only appear in untimed content of the game.
[/olist]
Word List Additions:

 "tequila" added to word list for Beverage category card. This word was submitted during the livestream on 2-22-23, but was rejected because it was not in the word list at that time.

notes.title: Regular Update 4.2.1 - Lots of Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This update includes lots of minor improvements and bug fixes. Most notably, the card deck now visually shows how many cards are remaining to be drawn. The most important bug fixes address multiple errors that caused the game to crash in certain circumstances and not save game progress made before the crash.

Improvements:

 Deck visually shows how many cards are left to be drawn (see screenshot GIF below). Also reversed-direction the deck is facing to more accurately reflect perspective view of player.
 Deck outer-glow animation plays to prompt player to draw the first card of the deck at the beginning of the game. This animation replaces the "Click Here" flashing text animation that previously appeared over the deck.
 Point modifiers (Double-Letter, Double-Word, and Word-And-A-Half) will only appear on consonant letter tiles (before, the distribution of point modifiers among consonant and vowel letter tiles was random).
 Hints Jars no longer decrement when hints are activated if there are no hints available to show.
 Changed color of circular symbol that appears in place of the deck of cards when the deck runs out of cards from green to yellow.
 Notification tooltip callout message "Out of hint jars!" shows when attempting to use hints if no hint jars are available for activating hints.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40540840/b43e3c0be65204fe494bad72f5e3325f3215c8ef.gif
Above: Screenshot GIF demonstrating how cards remaining in the deck are shown visually and update after each card is drawn.

Bug Fixes:

 Game user data is now immediately saved whenever a game/level is finished to ensure game progress is not lost if the game does not exit properly (i.e. game crashes).
 Fixed 2 rare, game-crashing bugs that occur at the start of a game (these are separate and independent from the game-crashing bugs that were fixed in build 4.1.2).
 Fixed bug causing game to sometimes crash when using Hint Jars to show hints for Noun, Adverb, Verb, and Adjective point cards.
 Fixed bug for word summary scrollview on post-game stats screen scrolling past the end of the word list. Also, fixed bug that caused the game to crash when attempting to scroll by click-and-dragging the scrollbar in this scrollview.

Word List Additions:

 "loogie", "spit", and "spittle" added to word list for Sticky category card

notes.title: Update 4.1.2 - Bug Fixes & New Way To Get Hints
notes.notes:
Hint jars are now awarded for completing levels! Hint jars can be used to reveal letters corresponding to a valid word for a card. Previously, the only way to gain hint jars was by drawing "Add Hint Jar" action cards that occasionally appear in decks of some levels. This update also comes with important bug fixes described below.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed: Rare bug causing game to crash at the very start of a level due to error in sorting initial 4 rows of letter tiles added to the tile grid.
 Fixed: Rare bug that causes game to crash when attempting to select lock/key letter tiles with the keyboard by typing letters while holding down the shift key.
 Fixed: Total stars earned stat shown on Select Level screen for untimed and timed levels is inconsistent with untimed or timed levels displayed.

Word List Additions:

 "hearse" added to word list for Vehicle category card.

Fun Fact: A "hearse" is a vehicle used for transporting a coffin during funeral services or for burial. See photos below.

notes.title: Update 4.1.1 - Increased Keyboard Functionality + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This update makes the game more friendly to keyboard users by increasing functionality of keyboard controls. Letters selected using the keyboard now follow a prioritization hierarchy in the event that there are two or more tiles of the same letter available for selection in the tile grid. The ordered hierarchy that determines priority selection of tiles with the same letter is as follows:
[olist]
 Starred tiles (only applicable to untimed levels in Solo Play)
 Letter tiles beneath gem tiles
 Letter tiles with Double-Word (x2) modifiers
 Letter tiles with Word-And-A-Half (x1.5) modifiers
 Letter tiles with Double-Letter (DL) modifiers
 Regular tiles without modifiers
[/olist]
Lock or Key letter tiles can only be selected with the keyboard if the SHIFT key is held down while typing the corresponding letters.

Bug Fixes:

 Fix for rare game-crashing bug that occurs only when more than 30 points are earned from a single word submission.
 Fixed bug that causes level buttons on Select Level screen to become pressed when clicking in blank areas on left or right sides of screen.
 Fix for text in objective sections of slide-out menu to be cutoff/hidden from view.
 Fixed bug causing text to be cut-off on last slide of How To Play screen.
 Changed Wordnet dictionary definition of NUN from "a woman religious" to "a religious woman."
 Fix for scroll position of level scroll view on Select Level screen not saving between game sessions.


Word List Additions:

 "loan" added to Investment category card word list
 "amphora" added to Storage Solution category card word list
 "buggy", "coupe", "forklift", "hatchback", "minivan", "tractor", "zamboni" added to Vehicle category card word list
 "dirk" added to word list for Weapon category card


Fun Fact: An "amphora" is a type of ceramic vessel used in ancient Greece and Rome with two handles and a narrow neck (see image below).

notes.title: Update On New Content Release
notes.notes:
As announced previously, Shuzzler will be unveiling a major content release that will feature new untimed levels! We are excited to announce that the new update will include a total of 120 new cards, including 40 all new category cards. Below is a look at a new variant of the word length cards, that, in addition to requiring spelling words of the specified length, require spelling words that are either nouns, verbs, adverbs, or adjectives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40540840/29220bbfef858e1cf64759cc43673d064ff0e785.png

It was the original hope to release this update before or during the Steam Summer Sale. At the time of writing this post, all of the new cards that will be included in the new update are finished. However, the delay is coming from the level design and playtesting process, which is taking longer than anticipated due to the new untimed levels following a different format from the original timed levels currently in the game.

Hoping to post more information about the update as it unfolds. However, the update is now in its final stages of development, and it will be big - at least 30 new levels big. Looking forward to seeing how the Steam community responds to it when it comes out.

notes.title: Update 3.4.0 - Dictionary Upgrade
notes.notes:
The WordNet dictionary has been upgraded from version 2.0 to version 3.0. This update also comes with fixes to issues with the dictionary missing a substantial number words (the missing words appeared to be those that were grouped by shared definitions in the WordNet dictionary). This means more word definitions are now available for reference in the slide-out in-game menu, and it is less likely that the dictionary will return "no definitions available" in place of actual word definitions.

Dictionary Limitations: 

 Plural, non-singular forms of words will return "no definitions available"
 Dictionary will only return a single definition for a word within each of the following word types: noun, verb, adjective, and adverb. For instance, if there are three different WordNet definitions for verb form of the word "sit", it will only show one of the three of these definitions


Word List Additions (For Category Card Word Lists): 

 "teal" added to color word list
 "cassock" added to clothing word list
 "gnat", "katydid", "mantis", "mealworm", "scarab", "treehopper", "weevil", and "weta" added to insect word list

notes.title: Patch 3.3.9.1 - Fix To Issues With Quick Play
notes.notes:
We apologize to those players that experienced issues with odd freezing behavior or submitted words not registering in Versus AI and Pass And Play game modes only. These issues were introduced in the last build (build 3.3.9), so would only affect those players whom have played these game modes recently.

In addition to these fixes, dictionary reference definitions are now available/accessible in the Versus AI and Pass And Play game modes.

notes.title: Update 3.3.9 - In-Game Dictionary Added!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40540840/4c31eaceafbf0f9150f18e562acced530998bad4.gif

The primary focus of this update is the addition of an in-game dictionary. Update notes with more details below:

notes.title: Patch 3.3.8.2
notes.notes:
Patch notes describing changes and bug fixes for version 3.3.8.2 below:

No longer possible to earn first-try badge for levels 1-3 of Miscellaneous category (this was done to avoid overchallenging new players on first few levels while they are still becoming familiar with gameplay). Still possible to earn first-try badge for all other levels if player beats the level on first attempt
Word list additions: "sweats", "sweatpants", and "ballgown" added to clothing word list; "seltzer" added to beverage word list; "crater" and "spacecraft" added to space word list
Fixed positioning error of first-try badge award on post-game screen for games where "Add Gems" action card is in the deck
Normalized click sound effect for ticker so peak volume is consistent with other sounds
Fixed minor bug where game timer text in upper right shifts slightly to right when timer starts

notes.title: Version 3.3.8 - BLACK SCREEN ERROR FIXED
notes.notes:
We want to apologize to those users whom experienced a black screen upon opening the game. This issue did not come to our attention until yesterday, which is the reason for making it a priority to roll this patch out today. In addition to fixing the black screen error, this build introduces the following changes:


    Mint completion sticker now awarded for earning all of the cards in a level. Previously, this sticker was earned for beating a level on the first try, but a new badge has now been added to award users for this achievement. Both of these badges/stickers appear on the level select screen and post-game stats screen after earned.
    Main word list expanded to include almost twice as many English words
    Fixed issue with sound effect for reveal hint button not loading properly
    Added 3 new words to instrument card word list: "samisen", "shamisen", and "sanxian"

notes.title: Shuzzler's Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40540840/e911a30d48dcee51fc7b8041ca1131d0c161d456.png
We are excited to announce that Shuzzler is on track to be released on Steam in January, 2022. We have held off for a while on this announcement because our team has been working hard on game development. Special thanks to our fans and those whom have offered their support and feedback up to this point. Our team still has a lot of work to prepare for release, but hope to be able to provide more info to come. Happy Holidays and be sure to keep Shuzzler on your wish list this holiday season! 🎄⛄️❄️
